title: Gilas Girls handily beaten by Australia to open Fiba U18 Asia Cup

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas Girls absorbed a 102-47 beatdown at the hands of defending champion Australia, 102-47, to open their campaign in the Fiba U18 Women’s Asia Cup on Sunday at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia. The Aussies gave Gilas big problems right out of the gate as they built a 30-8 lead at the end of the opening period. The Philippines simply couldn’t match Australia’s firepower as the game quickly went out of the Filipinos’ reach.
